# Attention-weighted approach to cointegration/pairs trading

A concept shared by **2** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #6,114. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed attention-weighted approach to cointegration/pairs trading: Test related securities for a stable long-run relationship and consider trades when the estimated spread deviates from its equilibrium, with safeguards for relationship breakdown. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
